thread:
Priya N: Hey team  first day remote from a hotel while moving cities. Laptop and monitor showed up but the monitor didn't include the VESA mount bracket I requested on the form, and the wireless keyboard in the box is the UK layout (I asked for US). Also the hotel's WiFi has a captive portal and I can't get Okta to finish SSO. Opening INC-15077. Anyone know the fastest fix?

Omar (IT): Welcome Priya! Oof on the layout mismatch. Can you snap a quick photo of the keyboard layout and the monitor backplate so I can confirm the part number? For the captive portal you can either (a) use your phone as a hotspot briefly or (b) tell me the hotel's public IP and I'll open a temporary exception for Okta. Which is easier?

Priya N: Photo: https://imgur.com/priya-key-mon.jpg  keyboard shows UK tick marks and monitor back has "ZenView32" and sticker AT-5590. Phone hotspot would work but I'm on limited data for the move. Hotel IP from whatismyip.org is 3.120.45.210.

wifi-bot: Ticket INC-15077 created; priority P2; assignee: Omar (IT).

Omar (IT): Thanks. I'll whitelist 3.120.45.210 for 60 minutes so you can complete SSO. Keyboard swap: we'll dispatch a courier with a US-layout wireless keyboard and the VESA bracket. Can you confirm whether you'd like the bracket to be installed before pickup (courier can collect the whole monitor) or would you prefer we ship components separately?

People Ops: Welcome @Priya N :tada: If pickup requires alternate shipping address while you move, DM me and I can update it. Also if you want an in-team buddy for the first day let me know.

Priya N: Thanks! Could you just send the bracket and keyboard separately so I can use the monitor now with a temporary stand? Pickup for the wrong keyboard later is fine. Also the Okta SSO worked after the whitelist  VPN connected.

courier-bot: INC-15077 shipping: US-layout keyboard (KB-RED-01) and VESA bracket (VESAB-32) dispatched via FedEx priority. Pickup for return of UK keyboard scheduled EOD tomorrow. Tracking: FDx 612345678901.

Omar (IT): Great. Quick follow-up in case others hit captive portal issues on day 1: run this to check if your mac sees the external display when connected via USB-C dock:
```bash
# show displays on macOS
system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType
```
If the monitor doesn't appear after swapping cables try an alternate cable or the HDMI adapter we include in the courier.

Priya N: Perfect, thanks Omar and People Ops  keyboard layout and bracket look replaced in the tracking. Appreciate the firewall whitelist shortcut  saved my first meeting. Closing INC-15077 once courier confirms delivery. :smile:
